text: Any Person is prohibited from unlawfully acquiring or collecting Personal Data other than their own with intent to benefit themselves or other persons to cause harm to a Personal Data Subject.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

text: Any Person is prohibited from unlawfully disclosing Personal Data other than their own.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

text: Any Person is prohibited from unlawfully using Personal Data other than their own.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf

text: Any Person is prohibited from producing falsified Personal Data or falsifying Personal Data with intent to benefit themselves or other persons to cause harm to other persons.
source_document: UU No. 27 of 2022 on Personal Data Protection (Indonesia) - English translation by Wishnu Basuki; KB 2/Indonesia/Personal Data Protection Law.pdf
